title: Add Inspector descriptions for exported C# members
body:

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

C# scripts can export fields and properties, but cannot define their Inspector tooltip descriptions in C# source. Add `[Description]` for exported fields, properties, and tool buttons. The source generator passes the description through the managed/native bridge to the editor's existing script documentation cache.

```csharp
[Export]
[Description("Maximum number of instances this node can create.")]
public int MaxInstances { get; set; } = 10;
```

## Additional information
- The attribute is separate from `[Export]` and has no effect on members that are not exported.
- Source-generator tests cover fields, properties, tool buttons, empty descriptions, string escaping, and inheritance. This change does not modify GDScript `##` parsing.
- The .NET editor and SDK build successfully. The source-generator suite passes (43/43), and the resulting editor and SDK were tested in a Godot project.
- Related discussion: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/discussions/5675. The C# export guide update is prepared in a separate godot-docs branch.
- Generated proposal https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/15594
- Documentation will be added to [tutorials/scripting/c_sharp/c_sharp_exports.rst](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs/blob/master/tutorials/scripting/c_sharp/c_sharp_exports.rst) to describe the new `[Description]` tag

[!INFO] **AI disclosure:** Codex assisted with tests, part of the implementation, documentation, and PR text. The contributor tested the resulting editor and SDK in a Godot project; automated source-generator tests and the local build also passed.
